question: Should ClawHub supersede the prior fixed MIT-0 policy and support declared standard MIT licenses for skill versions, including existing-version backfill?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but it changes a maintainer-stated license policy and may affect public API, docs, publishing consent, attribution expectations, and production data.

options.title: Confirm mixed MIT/MIT-0 before merge
options.body: Keep this PR open but require explicit maintainer/legal approval, real behavior proof, and a production backfill plan before landing it.

options.title: Narrow to future versions
options.body: Accept declared MIT only for new publishes/imports and track existing production backfill separately.

options.title: Reaffirm fixed MIT-0
options.body: Close or pause this PR and resolve the linked issue through clearer MIT-0 publication terms instead of supporting upstream package metadata.

recommendation.title: Confirm mixed MIT/MIT-0 before merge
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open but require explicit maintainer/legal approval, real behavior proof, and a production backfill plan before landing it.
